title: Cross-team data dry run + heuristic apportionment (Jun 2026)
content:
Purpose:
A very small scratch spreadsheet to run a data dry-run across product, infra, and SE to get a first-pass apportionment of effort and cost to cover ad-hoc cross-team tracking needs. Not final — just enough to scope stakeholder asks for next-week sync.

Context / prompt:
- We have ~7 one-off tracking asks from last 2 sprints (support, SE pilots, ops cadence). All want lightweight sheets/dashboards and owners.
- Goal: estimate effort (dev + ops manual upkeep) and categorize by: 1) ephemeral (<2 weeks), 2) short-term (2–8 weeks), 3) steady-state (>8 weeks).
- Need to decide which become: quick sheet, small dashboard, or product backlog ticket.

Assumptions (heuristic):
- Rapid sheet template setup = 0.5 dev-days (template + owners), manual daily upkeep = 0.1 dev-days/day (~0.5/week) if non-automated.
- Small dashboard (grafana/connections) = 3 dev-days + 0.2 ops-days/week for maintenance.
- Product backlog ticket (feature) = 8 dev-days + infra work as needed.
- Confidence: low/med/high assigned per row (subjective).

Quick table (columns: item | requestor | current need | suggested handle | est dev days | est weekly ops | category | owner | confidence | notes)

1) Customer pilot uptime ledger | SE pilot / Jonah | per-tenant daily rundown, manual today | quick dashboard (small) | 3 | 0.2/wk | short-term -> likely steady-state | Tom B | medium | needs KMS/PII check, data feed from Dedicated telemetry topic

2) Embeddings cost forwarder | Finance / Maya | weekly cost-by-customer csv | quick sheet + automated import | 1.5 | 0.1/wk | short-term | Priya N | high | can wire to billing export; script in Python (existing infra)

3) Rate-limit incident tracker | SRE / Elena | ad-hoc when incidents happen | ephemeral sheet | 0.5 | 0.0 | ephemeral | Ishaan M | low | manual postmortems to capture; might be replaced by incident DB later

4) Fallback coverage roster | Product ops / Sasha | routing fallbacks matrix for launches | backlog ticket (UI + export) | 8 | 0.3/wk | steady-state | Lena R | low | UX for rollouts; cross-team inputs required

5) Partner SLA exception log | Legal / R. Gomez | sporadic entries, legal review attach | quick sheet + template | 1 | 0.1/wk | short-term | Sofia A | medium | needs attachment column; link to ticketing system

6) Regional burst estimate sampler | Platform eng / N. Ito | capacity test outputs monthly | small dashboard | 3 | 0.2/wk | short-term | Tom B | medium | will feed into Dedicated capacity planning

7) One-off coverage handback list | Customer success / Priya | weekend handoffs during launches | ephemeral sheet -> archive | 0.5 | 0.0 | ephemeral | Priya N | high | copy to ops-runbook after event

Totals (heuristic sums):
- Total est dev-days if we implement suggestions: 17.5 dev-days
- Weekly ops burden sum (if all active): 1.0 ops-days/week

Quick sensitivity notes:
- If we convert 2 dashboards -> backlog features, swap 6 dev-days each and ops estimate increases; this is captured in alternative rows below.
- Billing export automation reduces ops burden for item 2 from 0.1/wk to ~0.02/wk after first month.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Who signs off on moving ephemeral trackers into product backlog? (proposal: product-ops + eng triage weekly)
- KMS/PII constraints on per-tenant dashboards for pilot telemetry (SRE + security signoff required).
- Where do we store final archived sheets? (drive path + tag naming convention?)

Action items (next 7 days):
- Tom B: prototype pilot uptime small dashboard (dashboard skeleton + list of telemetry topics) — due 2026-06-18.
- Priya N: wire billing export to sample sheet, attach script + instructions — due 2026-06-16.
- Ishaan: create ephemeral incident sheet template and add to ops-runbook repo — due 2026-06-12.
- Lena (owner): schedule 30m triage w/ product-ops, SRE, legal on 2026-06-22 to finalize what becomes backlog tickets.

Quick notes to self (informal):
- Keep this lightweight — main value is quick clarity for owners. Don’t overbuild.
- Add one column "archival policy" (auto-delete 90 days / manual) before handing to legal.
- Slack thread: #ops-short-lived-trackers has good context (see pinned msg from 2026-06-03).

Version history / micro log (quick):
- 2026-06-10: initial dry-run table, rough heuristics (Lena)
- 2026-06-12: Ishaan added incident template notes
- 2026-06-15: Priya pushed billing import sample (link in linked_artifacts)
- 2026-06-18: Tom prototype started (TBD)

If you’re reading: please add your line below with rough ests and confidence — this is intentionally messy.

End of sheet.
